description: Search one network of websites (courses on any subject, a multilingual dictionary and encyclopedia, live disaster warnings, visa rules, everyday tools) for the pages that answer a query. Returns up to 8 results, each with an id to pass to fetch, a title and an address a person can open. Use it when the user asks about a subject one of these sites covers; it does not search the wider web.

query.description: The subject, in a few words.

name: search
title: Search the network
